order_lines_amounts_ck.name: order_lines_amounts_ck
order_lines_amounts_ck.value: typeof("order_lines"."unit_price_net") = 'integer' AND typeof("order_lines"."unit_price_gross") = 'integer' AND typeof("order_lines"."base_unit_price") = 'integer' AND typeof("order_lines"."surcharge") = 'integer'

orders_totals_ck.name: orders_totals_ck
orders_totals_ck.value: typeof("orders"."subtotal_net") = 'integer' AND typeof("orders"."tax_total") = 'integer' AND typeof("orders"."total_gross") = 'integer' AND typeof("orders"."discount_total") = 'integer' AND typeof("orders"."shipping_total") = 'integer'

promotions_limits_ck.name: promotions_limits_ck
promotions_limits_ck.value: ("promotions"."usage_limit" IS NULL OR "promotions"."usage_limit" >= 0) AND ("promotions"."per_customer_limit" IS NULL OR "promotions"."per_customer_limit" >= 0)
